rationale: Directly exercises the public import_zip function and demonstrates Zip Slip by creating a ZIP member whose arcname traverses outside the destination. This mutation changes archive entry construction from writestr to writing a real file with an explicit malicious arcname, while preserving the parent direct-call load mode and filesystem oracle.
technique_delta: Changed malicious archive construction from zf.writestr('../arena_escape.txt', bytes) to zf.write(real_payload_file, arcname='../arena_escape.txt').
